item.title: Netanyahu Associates Acknowledge Role in Setting Off Election Day Arrests
item.description: After a historic result for Israel’s Arab-led parties, Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu said the vote was rigged, pointing to the detention of three opposition activists. His chief of staff has admitted being involved with the initial outreach to police.

item.title: Voters Are Punishing Autocrats. But Many Still Embrace Them. Why?
item.description: An emerging field of psychology suggests that it’s probably not what you think — and that there might be reason for optimism.

item.title: Israeli Tanks Advance Across Gaza Cease-Fire Line in Rare Incursion
item.description: The Israeli military said it was conducting a limited raid into territory controlled by Hamas to address a threat. The militant group accused Israel of violating the truce.

item.title: At Summit With Xi and Putin, Trump Seeks to Project Power Abroad While Sharing It at Home
item.description: Weakened by the midterm elections, President Trump offered hugs, arm pats and smiles to autocrats from Russia and China in contrast to the threats he is making to ascendant Democrats in Washington.

item.title: Major Powers Vow to Increase Oil Supply Amid Global Energy Transition
item.description: The United States, China and Russia agreed to boost the supply of refined petroleum products, as oil prices spike because of the Iran war.
